title: Geohash Tools
description: Encode coordinates or decode a geohash. Returns a lowercase hash, precision, rounded center, exact SW/NE bounds, and eight neighbors. Encoding defaults to 9 characters; precision is 1–12. Decoding accepts uppercase and surrounding whitespace. Coordinates include endpoints. Neighbors use the source library's grid wrapping at the antimeridian and poles (polar wrap is not a physical continuation). Invalid inputs return valid:false and an error message.

geohash.description: 1–12 geohash base32 characters; case insensitive, trimmed.
